subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical owner for Google Chat Space @mention ingestion, or should maintainers consolidate the remaining mention/thread routing work into another Google Chat issue?
rationale: Source review shows a plausible remaining mention-gate drop, but choosing the permanent fix boundary requires maintainer intent because the reported behavior now overlaps classifier, mention metadata, diagnostics, and related Space/thread routing items.

options.title: Keep This Issue Canonical
options.body: Use this issue to require live proof that @mentioned Spaces create and process `googlechat:group` sessions before closing.

options.title: Consolidate Into A Narrow Mention Issue
options.body: Move the remaining work into a dedicated Google Chat mention-metadata/diagnostics issue and close this only after linking that canonical target.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Space Routing
options.body: Track mention gating together with Google Chat thread/session routing, accepting a broader and slower product boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep This Issue Canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue to require live proof that @mentioned Spaces create and process `googlechat:group` sessions before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history in the Google Chat access-policy and monitor files that would define the remaining fix boundary.
